name: Squid Eyes
description: The ship whose collision with the Scourge created High and Dry.

description_citations.text: "Beckett Brass". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jareth Wake builds enchanted instruments to find Brass, and Lex Briggs crafts six charms to confound him; Swab's trickery lets him find the Scourge.
timeline.quote: Swab's trickery disrupted Lex's charms just long enough for Jareth to set his course

citation.text: "Beckett Brass", section "High and Dry". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The collision of the Scourge and Squid Eyes creates the floating city of High and Dry and leads to the formation of the Brazen Coalition.
timeline.quote: The literal collision of the Scourge and Squid Eyes led to the creation of the floating city of High and Dry

citation.text: "Beckett Brass", section "High and Dry". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The ships Scourge and Squid Eyes collide and tangle; Brass and Wake agree a truce and found High and Dry.
timeline.quote: agreeing to a truce when their ships became locked together
